description: This file defines a ConsumerProcessor class in Python that processes frames by consuming them from a producer queue, possibly transforming and forwarding them based on specified configurations. It handles frames for starting, ending, or canceling consumption and manages an internal asyncio task for concurrent frame handling.

classes.name: ConsumerProcessor
classes.description: A frame processor that consumes frames from a producer, optionally transforms them, and forwards them in a specified direction. Handles start, stop, and cancel frames to manage its internal consuming task.
